risk_assessment.rationale: The message is a classic bank-detail-change request for a specific invoice, directing payment away from the old account to new sort code and account number, and supplying a caller-controlled phone number. In context of frequent invoice fraud targeting this business, this warrants likely_fraud.

skeptic.argument: The recording identifies a named sender, a specific invoice (1047), and a callback number, and it transparently provides the new bank details rather than hiding them or demanding secrecy. Nothing in the provided facts shows Marrow Vale Couriers is not a real vendor to Ashgrove Bakery, that the number differs from one on file, or that the new account is mismatched, so a legitimate bank change remains plausible.
skeptic.evidence_that_would_change_my_mind: Call Marrow Vale Couriers on a number already on file (not 01632 960735) and ask whether they changed banks and recognize sort code 30-94-12 / account 5501 8273 for invoice 1047; if they deny it, I would switch to likely_fraud.
